title: All groups are good: the four-dimensional disc-embedding conjecture
exact_target: Can every prescribed capped-grope configuration be replaced by an immersed disk whose double-point loops become trivial in the target group, for every group?

sources.citation: Baykur, Kirby and Ruberman (eds.), K3 – A New Problem List in Low-Dimensional Topology, preliminary2026author version; Section4.5 scribed by Powell and Ray.
